content.short: CoinLedger is trusted, user-friendly cryptocurrency and NFT tax software.
content.description: CoinLedger is tax software for cryptocurrency and NFT activity, built to save time and maximize tax refunds. The platform enables users to import their transaction history across blockchains, dApps, wallets, and centralized exchanges, then generate an accurate tax report that covers their activity. By organizing diverse records into a clear view, CoinLedger helps streamline tax preparation and provide a reliable basis for filing.

resources.title: Crypto Accounting: Beginner's Guide
resources.tldr: The hard part is not the arithmetic. Your transactions sit across several exchanges, wallets and chains with no broker assembling a statement for you, unlike buying stock through Fidelity.

resources.title: Is Crypto Staking Worth It? Rewards, Risks & Taxes
resources.tldr: Locking coins to secure a proof-of-stake chain pays a yield whether you run a validator or delegate to one. Covers the mechanics first, then what the rewards do to your tax position.

resources.title: Prediction Markets Tax: Kalshi & Polymarket Guide
resources.tldr: The income is definitely reportable; what remains genuinely unsettled is the category, because the IRS has never published a formal ruling on prediction market contracts.
